body: BUG-2626 AC1 evidence is on the spec. After the bindings heal (116s, one-time), the merged dry-run tick takes 6.4-7.6s, but main also takes 6.4s in dry run, so it does not discriminate (the dry run skips reap). Ruling needed: may I run the heal plus one measure-shift-tick.py live probe on the primary with the merged binary? drain-mode-only fails, so no wave would launch. Or accept the dry run plus post-landing cron. Landing note: the heal must run before the first post-landing tick.
